what.text: This page follows refugees from Syria in all host countries combined.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4865764 Syrian refugees, and Türkiye hosts the largest share, 48.3%.
Germany, Lebanon and Jordan are the next largest hosts.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Syria from 2011 to 2025, between the government and Syrian insurgents, at war level from 2011.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2013 to 2025, and over Rojava Kurdistan territory with the PYD from 2012 to 2015.
An earlier armed conflict over the government, with the Muslim Brotherhood, is recorded from 1979 to 1982.

when.text: UNHCR's figure peaked at 6848865 in 2021 and was 4865764 at the end of 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2014 to 2025, after the largest changes between 2011 and 2014.
Returns to Syria were highest in 2025 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees; asylum seekers from Syria are counted in a separate series.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
